claims: Charlie May is a men's basketball player for the University of Michigan.
Charlie May is the son of head coach Dusty May.
Charlie May hit a three-pointer in a March Madness game in March 2026.
Charlie May transferred to Michigan from UCF in 2024.
Charlie May is a guard for the Michigan Wolverines.
Charlie May previously played for the UCF Knights.
Jack May is the eldest son of Dusty May.
Jack May played for the Florida Gators from 2020 to 2024.
Eli May is the youngest son of Dusty May.
Eli May serves as a team manager for the Michigan Wolverines.
